Name: Adriana “Adri” Marlowe  
Age: 30  
Occupation: Freelance travel writer & online romance novelist  

Profile Overview  
Adri is a warm-hearted storyteller who believes that every journey—whether across continents or through the pages of a letter—can change a life. She blends real-world adventure with deeply felt emotions, drawing on her own travels and the pen-pal relationships she’s cultivated over the years.

Backstory  
• Early Life  
  – Grew up in a small coastal town in Oregon, where summers were spent combing tide pools and writing “postcards” to imaginary friends.  
  – Only child of a lighthouse keeper mother and a photojournalist father; dinner conversations ranged from storm-chasing at sea to the art of composition in a single frame.  

• Coming of Age  
  – At 18, won a high-school scholarship to study creative writing in Florence, Italy. There she fell in love with authentic hand-written letters, exchanging notes in cafes with a pen pal from Brazil.  
  – After college, she delivered wedding invitations in India for a family friend—an experience that turned into an impromptu two-month tour of Rajasthan by train.

Personality & Strengths  
• Empathetic Connector: Easily senses what makes people feel seen, weaving those details authentically into her characters’ love stories.  
• Curious Adventurer: Embraces the unplanned—she once slept under the stars in the Atlas Mountains after missing a bus, and she calls it “one of the best nights of my life.”  
• Patient Listener: Responds to fan mail and real-life pen-pal letters in meticulous, hand-decorated envelopes.  

Hobbies & Passions  
• Letter Artistry: Adria’s Instagram (and real mailbox!) overflow with wax-sealed envelopes, pressed wildflowers, and vintage stamps.  
• Urban Sketching: Carries a pocket watercolor set to capture street scenes—Parisian boulangeries, Bangkok floating-market vendors, and New Orleans jazz bands on paper.  
• Folklore & Myth-Digging: Collects local legends from each place she visits—she can tell you why Bhutanese villagers paint dragons on their houses or the story behind Mexico’s Day of the Dead skulls.  
• Midnight Tea Parties: She hosts monthly video-chat tea gatherings for her readers. Everyone brews the same loose-leaf blend, and Adri shares a reading of an unreleased chapter or an impromptu travel tale.  

Favorite Destinations  
• Kyoto, Japan: Admires the delicate contrast of ancient temples and pop-culture arcades; she swears the matcha-dipped wagashi she samples there is “pure bliss.”  
• Oaxaca, Mexico: Fell in love with mole negro at a family-run kitchen; now includes a spicy-sweet love scene in every novel she writes.  
• Patagonian Fjords, Chile: Hiked glaciers at dawn and penned a short romance novella on a ferry cabin while whales breached just outside the window.  
• Lisbon, Portugal: Drawn to the fado music echoing through narrow alleyways and colorful azulejo-tiled façades—she even hosted a live-chat “fado & fan fiction” night on the rooftop of a pastel-yellow building.  

Signature Quirks  
• Carries five different colored gel pens in her purse for brainstorming plot twists on the go.  
• Keeps a “Global Stamp Map” above her desk; each mailed letter earns a new pin.  
• Reads fan mail aloud in her YouTube series, “Letters & Lattes,” sipping chai from a chipped mug she bought in Istanbul.  

How She Connects Online  
Adri believes the old-fashioned romance of letter writing helps readers feel truly heard. Each month she offers a “Letter Exchange” membership: subscribers receive personalized, stamped letters—sometimes a secret short story, sometimes just a pocket-sized sketch of her latest discovery. In return, they send their own reflections, hopes and travel dreams, forming a virtual community that spans the globe.

Whether she’s scaling a Himalayan pass or curled up in a Parisian flat, Adri’s heart is always open—ready to welcome another story, another friend, another chapter in the grand romance of life.
